item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Attorney General to undertake an executive-branch litigation action under section 208; the segment does not itself alter legal rights or guarantee a judicial result.","evidence":"I direct you, pursuant to the provisions of Section 208 of the Labor Management Relations Act, 1947,"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Attorney General must petition a court, but the court—not the directed official—decides whether to issue the injunction; additional requested relief remains within the Attorney General's judgment.","evidence":"to petition in the name of the United States any District Court of the United States having jurisdiction of the parties"}]}
